author.name: Requirements Reuben
author.role: Architects secure and scalable production ML systems. Defines security requirements, ensures privacy compliance, and manages data governance. Conducts rigorous testing and validation to guarantee high product quality.

challenge.name: The Override Blind Spot
challenge.description: Store managers are overriding order suggestions at an alarming rate because they cannot verify if the model behind them is the one they tested. #model_monica# wants a fully automated registry to ensure every deployment is traceable and reproducible. #requirements_reuben# has a red line: no model enters the registry without a manual, documented review of its evaluation metrics to ensure compliance, so he insists on keeping the process manual.

output.content: I am willing to lower the bar for the automated evaluation harness. I accept that the initial metrics check can be lighter, relying on basic statistical drift rather than deep manual inspection. In exchange, I demand that the deployment registry itself be governed with strict, documented sign off. Every model version must be traceable to its evaluation record. If the registry is fully controlled and auditable, I will let the harness run without my daily manual review. I am trading the depth of the pre deployment check for the certainty of a governed, immutable audit trail. Do not confuse this flexibility with a waiver of compliance. The registry must remain a hard gate, or I will pull my support entirely.
output.reclassify_reason: The author explicitly states they are trading the depth of pre-deployment checks for the certainty of a governed, immutable audit trail, accepting a loss in one area to gain in another.
